instruction: Compare iPad mini with iPad (10th generation) and iPad (9th generation)

metadata.explanation: Task requires comparing 3 iPad models (mini and standard generations) on Apple's website. Evaluator checks that the active tab URL contains the modelList parameter with the 3 specified iPad models (order-independent). Similar complexity to original task, just different model selection.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts active tab URL and parses modelList query parameter
Split list functionality properly handles comma-separated model identifiers in URL
Metric correctly compares extracted model list against expected values
Order-independent comparison (ignore_list_order) is semantically appropriate for product comparison task
All 3 required iPad models are verified in the expected values
Proper error handling: missing URL parameters return None, which causes metric to return 0.0 (failure)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks all requirements from the instruction
